$moduleId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['moduleId', 'version', 'questions', 'uploadedBy', 'uploadedAt']) && newData.child('moduleId').val() === $moduleId && newData.child('version').isString() && newData.child('questions').hasChildren() && newData.child('uploadedBy').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('uploadedAt').isNumber()

$version..validate: newData.hasChildren(['moduleId', 'version', 'answers', 'uploadedBy', 'uploadedAt']) && newData.child('moduleId').val() === $moduleId && newData.child('version').val() === $version && newData.child('answers').hasChildren() && newData.child('uploadedBy').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('uploadedAt').isNumber()

newData.hasChildren(['uid', 'moduleId', 'version', 'answers', 'submittedAt']) && newData.child('uid').val() === $uid && newData.child('moduleId').val() === $moduleId && newData.child('version').val() === $version && newData.child('answers').hasChildren() && newData.child('submittedAt').isNumber()
